title: EEG Moments Dataset (EMD)
description: The EEG Moments Dataset (EMD) contains EEG responses from 6 human subjects viewing 1,102 naturalistic 3-second videos presented with their audio tracks. Each subject viewed the 1,000-video training set 6 times and the 102-video testing set 24 times. Eye tracking data (gaze and pupil size) were recorded during the experiment. The videos carry human annotations for objects, scenes, actions, sentence descriptions, spoken transcriptions, and memorability. EMD is the EEG companion to the BOLD Moments fMRI dataset.
methods_description: Raw EEG and simultaneous eye-tracking data were recorded over multiple sessions while subjects maintained central fixation during presentation of 3-second videos with audio. Subjects saw the training videos 6 times and the test videos 24 times. Data are provided in BIDS format, along with preprocessed EEG and eye-tracking derivatives and stimulus metadata.
